::: {#def-replication}
#### Replication

A **replication** of a simulation is one run of its steps:
draw a data set $\dsn{X}^{(m)}$ from the [data-generating process](#def-data-generating-process),
then compute the [estimate](estimation.qmd#def-estimate) $T_m \eqdef \hparam\paren{\dsn{X}^{(m)}}$
of an [estimator](estimation.qmd#def-estimator) $\hparam$,
for $m = 1, \ldots, M$.
Different replications draw their data sets independently.
:::
